newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 18.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 18.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones rose 39.98 points to 6,308.33. PLDT's ADR was unchanged at $57 1/2.
* On Tuesday, the peso closed at 26.289 to a U.S. dollar from 26.285.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,093.21, down 22.37.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average rate was at 10.90625 from 10.9375 pct.
* The Senate ratified yesterday the proposed amendments to the expanded value-added tax and government losses are expected to amount to 500 million pesos. (BULLETIN/JOURNAL)
* The Department of Budget and Management said government is committed to pay the 2.4 billion peso claims of the oil companies from the Oil Price Stabilisation Fund. (BULLETIN/PHILIPPINE STAR)

* The revised implementing rules and regulations of the Mining Act to be signed on Thursday will give equal emphasis to environment and economic gains, the Chamber of Mines of the Philippines said. (BULLETIN)

* The Philippine Racing Club (PRCI) is ready to implement its plan to convert a 26-hectare Sta.Ana property in Manila into a mixed commercial and residential center, PRCI chairman Edgardo Espiritu said. (MALAYA)

* The Central Bank has narrowed down to three the number of pre-qualified bidders vying for the Philippine National Bank's 60 percent equity in PNB-Republic Planters Bank. The bidders are Malaysian Bank, Equitable Banking Corp and a group of investors led by investment banker Francisco Dizon. (INQUIRER)
* Digital Telecommunications Philippines Inc is set to sign a correspondentship agreement next week with British Telecom. (MANILA TIMES)
